title: SOBORO Miao unit cards and 2D porthole ONLY. 1.0.0
author: Kerberos 2
description:
[img https://www.loverslab.com/uploads/monthly_2024_08/image.png.91de440220b82274f3bad32390f18a31.png]

This SOBORO's mod currently causes an issue where Miao in stage 2 is facing backwards in her 3d window on diplomacy menu. (after loading a save). This mod inherits that issue as well.

This mod adds Soboro's unit cards and 2D portholes, but leaves the original Lazy Icarus 3D models. You still need to have all of Lazy's Miao files enabled. Use with Lazy's models enabled only, do not have any of SOBORO's files enabled.

If you want SOBORO's 3D models, then instead use SOBORO's files linked below which already include these assets (and do not use this one).
